name: What STC rating should I look for in sound insulating windows for my Bay Area home?

mainEntity.name: What STC rating should I look for in sound insulating windows for my Bay Area home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homes in typical urban or suburban areas of the Bay Area experiencing moderate noise, an STC rating of 35-40 is often sufficient to notice a significant improvement. If your home is near a major highway, airport, or high-traffic commercial zone, you might consider windows with an STC rating of 40-45 or higher for optimal sound reduction. Our contractors can assess your specific noise challenges and recommend an appropriate STC rating during a site visit, ensuring your investment effectively addresses your noise concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: For Bay Area homes, an STC rating of 35-40 is usually good for moderate noise. For high-noise areas, consider 40-45 or higher. A contractor can recommend the best rating.
